title: User Authentication Success
description: Verify that users can successfully authenticate with valid credentials using the authentication system.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
User is redirected to the platform dashboard with appropriate role-based access.

title: User Authentication Failure
description: Verify that authentication fails with invalid credentials and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username/email or incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Authentication is denied and an error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Enforcement
description: Verify that multi-factor authentication is triggered and required after initial successful login for users with MFA enabled.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials for a user with MFA enabled.
System prompts for MFA code input.
Enter valid MFA code.
User is granted access to the platform dashboard.
Enter invalid MFA code.
Access is denied and error message for invalid MFA code is shown.

title: Blacklisting and Violation Tracking
description: Verify that the security system correctly blacklists users/IPs after repeated violations and denies further access.

steps.description: Attempt multiple failed logins from the same user or IP to trigger violation threshold.
Security system records violation attempts and blacklists user/IP.
Attempt to login again with the blacklisted user or from the blacklisted IP.
Access is denied with a message indicating the blacklisting status.

title: Livestock Registration and Batch Creation
description: Verify that users can register individual livestock and create/manage batches correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to livestock registration page.
Input required livestock information such as ID, tag, species, birthdate, etc.
Create a new batch and assign livestock to the batch.
Submit the registration and batch creation.
Livestock and batch are saved and visible in the management lists.

title: Livestock Mutation Handling
description: Verify that lifecycle mutations (e.g. sale, illness, transfer) can be recorded and reflect expected status changes.

steps.description: Select an existing livestock record.
Initiate a mutation event such as transfer or sale.
Input necessary mutation data fields and submit.
Mutation is recorded and livestock status updates accordingly.

title: Feed and Supply Stock Mutation Handling
description: Verify that supply mutations can be created with flexible destination handling and usage is tracked accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to supply management.
Create new supply stock entry.
Initiate supply mutation transaction with stock adjustments.
Specify flexible destination(s) for the mutation.
Submit the mutation.
Supply stock and mutation records update correctly and usage is tracked.

title: Daily Recording Creation and Validation
description: Verify that daily livestock recording is correctly created with modular payloads and validation.

steps.description: Access the recording creation interface.
Input daily recording data including health, feed, and other modular payload data.
Attempt to submit incomplete or invalid data.
System provides validation error messages and prevents submission.
Submit valid recording data.
Recording is saved and reflected in real-time analytics dashboard.

title: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Data Accuracy
description: Check that real-time analytics dashboards correctly aggregate and display current livestock and supply metrics.

steps.description: Perform various livestock events and supply mutations.
Navigate to analytics dashboard.
Dashboard updates metrics accurately reflecting recent transactions and status changes.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify users only have access to allowed features and data as per assigned roles and multi-tenant company settings.

steps.description: Login as a user with a restricted role.
Attempt to access features or data outside role permissions.
Access is denied or hidden features are not accessible.
Login as an admin with multi-tenant privileges.
Verify ability to configure roles and audit logs per tenant.
Admin can manage tenant-specific users and see audit trails correctly.

title: Audit Trail Logging Verification
description: Verify that all user actions affecting data are recorded in audit trails with accurate timestamps and user info.

steps.description: Perform create, update, and delete actions on livestock and supply records.
Access audit trail logs through admin interface.
Audit logs reflect all actions with correct user identity, timestamp, and details.

title: Performance Metrics API Response Validation
description: Validate that performance metrics API endpoints return data within response time criteria and correct format.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/performance/metrics endpoint.
Response is received within 200ms for 95% of requests.
Response contains required metrics data fields in correct JSON format.

title: Security Status API Verification
description: Verify that the security status endpoint returns up-to-date security monitoring information.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/security/status endpoint.
Response contains valid security status data including blacklisting and violation counts.

title: RESTful API Authentication and Rate Limiting
description: Verify that RESTful API v2 enforces authentication and rate limits requests appropriately.

steps.description: Send API requests with valid authentication tokens below rate limit.
Requests succeed and return expected data.
Send API requests exceeding configured rate limit.
API returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests error.
Send API requests without authentication.
API returns 401 Unauthorized error.

title: Mobile App Offline Data Synchronization
description: Verify that mobile users can capture livestock and supply data offline and that data syncs correctly when online.

steps.description: Use mobile app in offline mode and enter new livestock recording data.
Data is saved locally without errors.
Reconnect to network and trigger data synchronization.
Data uploads successfully to backend and reflects in main platform databases.

title: Mobile App Camera and GPS Integration
description: Verify that mobile application can capture images and GPS location data for field operations and attach them correctly to livestock records.

steps.description: Open livestock record in mobile app.
Use camera feature to capture an image.
Capture GPS location using device location services.
Attach captured media and location data to the record and save.
Image and GPS data are saved and viewable in livestock record.

title: API Webhook Functional Test
description: Verify that webhooks trigger and deliver correct payloads for livestock and supply events.

steps.description: Configure webhook endpoint to receive livestock creation events.
Create a new livestock record through API or UI.
Webhook is triggered and receives the correct event payload.

title: Database Query Optimization Under Load
description: Validate that core database queries related to livestock, supply, and recording handle large datasets efficiently without performance degradation.

steps.description: Populate database with large datasets representing thousands of livestock and supply records.
Perform complex data retrieval operations including joins and filters.
Queries complete within acceptable response time (under 200ms for 95% queries).

title: UI Responsiveness and Theme Switching
description: Verify UI responsiveness across devices and correctness of theme switching on dashboards and components using Vue.js 3.

steps.description: Access platform on desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport sizes.
UI adapts layout and remains fully functional without visual defects.
Switch themes from light to dark and vice versa via settings.
Theme changes apply immediately and all UI components reflect correct theme styling.

title: Compliance with GDPR Data Privacy
description: Verify that user data can be deleted or anonymized per GDPR requirements and user data access requests are handled correctly.

steps.description: Request user data export via platform.
Accurate user data is provided securely.
Request user data deletion.
User personal data is deleted or anonymized and no longer accessible.
